gaps.explanation: Statement p6 (GAAP governmental funds statement) Total revenues: General Fund 67,623,705, Streets Fund 12,586,124, Other Governmental Funds 9,458,519 = 89,668,348. Detail: General Fund Budgetary Comparison Schedule p14 Actual Total Revenues 68,236,068 + Streets Fund schedule p15 Actual Total revenues 12,486,214 + nonmajor combining statement columns (pp16-20) 9,458,519 (ties to Other Governmental Funds) = 90,180,801. Gap -512,453 = -(68,236,068 - 67,623,705 = 612,363) + (12,586,124 - 12,486,214 = 99,910). Budgetary basis vs GAAP; no fund column is missing and nothing is duplicated. No fix.

Statement p6 Total expenditures: General 55,468,083, Streets 17,777,995, Other Governmental 11,830,269 = 85,076,347. Detail: p14 General budgetary Actual 54,622,771 + p15 Streets 17,078,581 + nonmajor columns 11,830,269 = 83,531,621. Gap 1,544,726 = (55,468,083 - 54,622,771 = 845,312) + (17,777,995 - 17,078,581 = 699,414). Budgetary basis vs GAAP; no fix.

Statement p6 prints transfers gross: General in 7,632,185 / out (14,019,157); Streets in 7,466,280 / out (600,000); Other Governmental in 3,470,740 / out (308,740). The budgetary schedules print only 'Operating transfers, net': General (6,386,972) (p14) = 7,632,185 - 14,019,157; Streets 6,866,280 (p15) = 7,466,280 - 600,000. Detail in = Streets net 6,866,280 + nonmajor gross 3,470,740 = 10,337,020 vs statement 18,569,205. Gap 8,232,185 = General in 7,632,185 + Streets out 600,000, whose money is already inside the two net lines in detail; adding the p6 gross amounts would count it twice. No fix.

Statement p6 Transfers out 14,927,897 (General 14,019,157 + Streets 600,000 + Other 308,740). Detail out = General net (6,386,972) (p14) + nonmajor (308,740) = 6,695,712. Gap 8,232,185 = 14,019,157 + 600,000 - 6,386,972, the mirror of the transfers_in gap (netted in the budgetary schedules). No fix.

Statement p6 'Subscription proceeds' 269,540 in the General Fund column only (Total 269,540 = JSON debt_proceeds); 'Proceeds from sales of capital asset' General Fund 6,525 (= JSON other_financing). The General Fund budgetary schedule p14 prints no subscription proceeds, so the 269,540 is in no detail line: added in the General Fund from p6. After the add, debt-proceeds detail = 269,540 = debt_proceeds. The other non-transfer other-financing detail line is p14 'Proceeds from sales of capital assets' 5,942 (budgetary basis), the same row as p6's 6,525 (GAAP): non-transfer OF detail 269,540 + 5,942 = 275,482 vs debt_proceeds + other_financing 269,540 + 6,525 = 276,065; difference 583 = 6,525 - 5,942 is the budgetary vs GAAP basis of the sale-of-assets row. Adding the p6 6,525 would count that row twice, so it is not added.

gaps.explanation: Proprietary statement p8 (Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds; fund columns Electric Fund, Water Fund, Sewer Fund, Nonmajor Landfill Fund; Total and Internal Service Fund on p9, not used). No business-type line is in detail and the trim has no utility schedule. JSON receipts (Total column) = Consumers 94,345,280 + Municipal and interdepartmental 2,276,013 + Wholesale 17,736,390 + Tap fees 42,733 + Other revenue 4,149,636 + Interest income 2,613,378 + Intergovernmental/grants 44,016 + Gain (loss) on disposal of assets 39,924 + Special assessments (19,370) = 121,228,000; same rows added per column. Electric 68,351,781 + 2,087,690 + 17,736,390 + 3,366,602 + 1,320,528 + 17,548; Water 6,476,013 + 188,323 + 41,571 + 317,467 + 200,762 + 3,376; Sewer 15,488,103 + 1,162 + 439,808 + 392,505 + 44,016 + (19,370); Landfill 4,029,383 + 25,759 + 699,583 + 19,000. Each row's columns re-add to the p9 Total. Sum 121,228,000 = statement.
